attributes.axis_log: AXIS1 KEPT (real 486->482): the anode-scan loop at source lines 3083-3104 had its load placement inverted against the target. The target loads `hitNode->active` ONCE into r9 immediately before the loop (+0x484) and re-reads `c->anodes` inside each iteration; ours re-read `active` every iteration while address-CSE-hoisting `c+0xB4` and `c+0xB0` into registers before it. Fix: introduce a block-local `void *activeNode` initialised from the member right after the MBSetObject call and compare against it in the loop test, leaving the c-base sites untouched. The whole @0x484-0x4c8 cluster disappeared from --ops. AXIS2 CONFLICT, reverted: replaced `extern const char lbl_80346574[]` with the recovered literal "%sD%s" (the .sdata2 object at 0x80346574, size 0x6, read from the retail DOL). This DID reproduce the target's single-instruction EMB_SDA21 address form and removed our ADDR16_HA/LO `lis`+`addi` pair - multiset improved 18t->17t - but dropped us to 603/604 instructions and real 482->587. AXIS3 CONFLICT, reverted: passing `*(u8**)(hitNode + offsetof(CritterHitNode, descriptor))` instead of the cached `hitDescriptor` local for sprintf's 4th argument, to match the target's `lwz r6,0(r30)` re-read. Same signature as AXIS2 - 603/604, 17t, real 482->559. Two identical A/B signatures kill the sprintf-cluster axis for this pass.
